content: OLED subtitle rendering: pure black (#000000) background with white text. OLED pixels at black are fully off - perfect for cinema dark environment. Burn-in prevention: dynamic content (changing subtitles) naturally distributes wear. Additional: pixel shifting, avoid static UI elements, lower brightness. For subtitle player, burn-in risk is inherently low since text changes every few seconds. Use system fonts for crispness, large font sizes for readability in dark theater.
